column1: # DIGITISED from Hughes et al. 2022 Brain Stimul Fig 3B (PMID 35671947; PMC10308851 image nihms-1908014-f0003.jpg 1050x611 px). Mean normalised intensity (normalised to report after 1st train; 7 electrodes, 100 Hz, 60 uA; 1 s on / 5 s off x50 then 1 s on / 61 s off x5). Calibration: x ticks 0..600 s at px 60..391.5 (0.5525 px/s); y ticks 1.0@204, 0.2@483.5 px. Method: blue marker centres = 5x5 blue-fill maximum within +/-3 px of expected report column, then 7x7 centroid; duplicates removed. Markers overlap (6 s spacing = 3.3 px), so only a subset of the 50 adaptation points is resolvable; x uncertainty ~+/-3 s, y ~+/-0.01. First plotted point is 1.0 by construction. Paper-stated anchors: end of adaptation 43.5+/-10%, end of recovery 72.6+/-7%.
